title: Understanding Zero Correlation
text: A correlation of zero between two variables means there is no linear relationship between them. This doesn't necessarily mean there is no relationship at all, just that it isn't linear.

title: Interpreting the Scatterplot
text: If the correlation is zero, the scatterplot of the data points will not show any clear pattern or trend. The points will appear randomly scattered.
